eyebrow: AI, RAG & MACHINE LEARNING ARCHITECTURE SHOWCASE
headline: How I Build Production AI, RAG & ML Systems
subheadline: Explore the skills, data pipelines, and visual system flows behind two production-grade R&D projects, with direct links to inspect the contracts and documentation on GitHub.

pillars.title: Strict Data Contracts & Repair
pillars.detail: Every LLM output and vision extraction is validated against typed schemas so ungrounded claims are blocked before reaching users.

pillars.title: Local-First Hybrid Search & Geospatial
pillars.detail: Combines offline ONNX vector embeddings, Rust Tantivy BM25 keyword search, and DuckDB geospatial joins with zero cloud lock-in.

pillars.title: Agentic Control & Deterministic Replay
pillars.detail: Time-embargoed ML training, explicit tool-calling risk gates, and bit-for-bit replay harnesses so every automated decision is auditable.
